measurement_notes.cpu: Process CPU percent where 100 means one logical core.
measurement_notes.ram: Summed RSS of the backend's browser process tree; shared pages may be counted more than once. Camoufox tree = camoufox + plugin-container children; Chrome tree = processes named *chrome*.
measurement_notes.throughput: local_simulator_checks_per_second is a local page rate, not Queue-it throughput or a staging-safe level.
measurement_notes.fingerprints: No fingerprint/browser-device values are read or compared.

camoufox-unserialized.reason: context creation failures or browser crashes

scenarios.evidence: real browser + LocalQueueSimulator + SQLite + state files

scenarios.title: Close every browser process, relaunch, restore parked sessions
scenarios.evidence: real browser processes fully stopped and relaunched

scenarios.title: Application restart with stranded leases and foreign-backend rows
scenarios.evidence: repository/state/browser fully stopped; new objects on the same files

scenarios.title: SIGKILL one managed browser process with 0 / 1 / many active contexts
scenarios.evidence: real SIGKILL of the top-level browser process

scenarios.title: Two managed processes: kill one, the healthy one keeps serving
scenarios.evidence: real SIGKILL of one of two top-level browser processes

scenarios.title: Kill and recover one managed browser slot 10 times
scenarios.evidence: repeated real SIGKILL of the top-level browser process

scenarios.title: SIGKILL a managed browser while restores/checks are in flight
scenarios.evidence: slowed local pages keep contexts live; real SIGKILL mid-check

scenarios.title: Transfer, state, provenance, navigation, and identity failures
scenarios.evidence: dedicated synthetic sessions; faults injected by the local simulator
